description:
Count clinical trials matching search criteria on ClinicalTrials.gov.
Data: ClinicalTrials.gov (API v2) · table studies — one record = one registered clinical study (its current registry record).
Key: protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId.
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Studies registered on ClinicalTrials.gov at the recorded data timestamp; registry search expands synonyms, so a match is not a literal text match.

advanced_filter.description: Matched by the source's search engine: an Essie expression ANDed with the other filters.

condition.description: Matched by the source's search engine: registry search: synonym expansion and word match ('Korea' matches both Koreas).

country.description: Values of protocolSection.contactsLocationsModule.locations[].country (see mcp__data__vocab). Defaults to 'United States'; pass null for no restriction.

eligibility_text.description: Matched by the source's search engine: each phrase is quoted into AREA[EligibilityCriteria]"...".

intervention.description: Matched by the source's search engine: registry search over intervention names and synonyms.

term.description: Matched by the source's search engine: registry search over every indexed field.
